full_judgment: 6. Mr. A. R.M. Amirul Islam Chowdhury, the learned Deputy Attorney-General, appearing on behalf of the respondent No. 1, drew out attention to certain facts which appear from the pleadings in the suit and which, in his opinion, would tend to justify the conclusion arrived at by learned Subordinate Judge. First, he referred to the schedule to the plaint where the plot No. 128 on which the temple was alleged to have existed was shown a "pucca bari". Next, be referred to certain passages in the plaint which did not state that C.S-dag Nos. 127 and 128 were being used by the public for religious worship. It was contended by him that even if the plots including plot No. 128 was ever, at any point of time, used as a place for public worship not only the khatian but also the municipal records would show the purpose for which these plots were used, for, such land would then have been entitled to exemption from the municipal rates. He also further contended that when the municipality gave an order of demolition of the building situated on C.S. plot No. 128 in respect of which an exemption order was granted by the requisitioning authority the appellants did not oppose such demolition order either by making a petition to the municipality or moving any court of law for restraining the municipality from effecting the demolition. On our queries it has been stated that the respondent No. 2 is in possession of the entire plots to which the appellants have claimed their title. Since we are of the view that if the lands to which the appellants have laid their claim can be brought within the exception provided in the second proviso to section 3 of the Act, the order passed in respect of the same by the requisitioning authority should be considered as null and void, we would refrain from finding whether the plaintiffs' suit would be maintainable. The question whether the requisition of lands for a private voluntary organization like that of the respondent No. 2 is for public purpose or not may also be determined in the suit filed by the appellants.
